messages:
Ravi Nambiar: Heads-up — I uploaded the corrected weights and a candidate AWQ build for mpt-30b to s3: s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/2026-03-17-awq-cand/ :tada:
Chris Lee: Nice. Which checkpoint name?
Ravi Nambiar: checkpoint-epoch42-awq.pt and tokenizer.json (v2). Also added README.md with export steps.
Elaine Park: quick check — tokenizer.json shows pad_token_id: 0 but our serving vocab expects 1. That mismatch will break prefix caching. :eyes:
Ravi Nambiar: ah, good catch. I ran convert_tokenizer.py but must've missed --pad-offset. Re-uploading tokenizer now.
Jordan (infra): FYI, serving config needs kv_cache.enabled=true and quant.profile=awq by default for this deploy. If we change to gptq we need another kernel set.
Maria Gomez: For the quant approval checklist: what was the calibration set size? we've been aiming for >= 2k sequences for stable AWQ calibs.
Ravi Nambiar: calib dataset is mpt-internal-sample-v2 (~2500 sequences). Ran a quick parity run: top1 token accuracy delta vs FP16 averaged 0.7% (within our 1% soft limit).
Chris Lee: Can you paste the command you used to run the AWQ calibration so I can reproduce locally?
Ravi Nambiar: Sure —

Chris Lee: ```bash
# run on a single A100 node, mounts s3
python -m redwood.quant.calibrate \ 
  --weights s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/2026-03-17-awq-cand/checkpoint-epoch42-awq.pt \ 
  --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/2026-03-17-awq-cand/tokenizer.json \ 
  --calib-dataset s3://redwood-datasets/mpt-calib/mpt-internal-sample-v2 \ 
  --samples 2500 \ 
  --out-dir ./calib_runs/epoch42-awq
```

Ravi Nambiar: Exactly that. I also set --clip-quant-buckets=64 for stability.
Elaine Park: Re tokenizer quirk — some of our inference pipelines expect BOS id == 1. If the tokenizer uses 0 for BOS we'll need to add a small remap at runtime or re-export with correct ids. Which is easier?
Jordan (infra): Runtime remap is doable via serving config: token_remap { from: 0 to: 1 } but it complicates KV cache lifetimes. Prefer re-exporting if small.
Maria Gomez: On the AWQ vs GPTQ decision — AWQ gave smaller size and faster decode here, but GPTQ had slightly better perplexity (delta -0.4). We should document the tradeoff and pick AWQ for Dedicated pilot, but tag GPTQ as rollback.
Ravi Nambiar: Agreed. I'll update the onboarding checklist to set quant.method=awq and quant.fallback=gptq. Also flag FP8 research separately — not part of this canary.
calib-bot: Calibration run submitted: job_id=calib-2190012345-01, status=running (logs: https://internal.jobs/2190012345)
Chris Lee: Ping me once the job finishes — I'll run the smoke serve locally with the new tokenizer.
Ravi Nambiar: Will do. Also left a small config snippet in README:

Chris Lee: ```yaml
serving:
  kernel_profile: awq_default
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    persistence: session
  token_remap: [] # keep empty if tokenizer exported correctly
  metrics: [latency, p50, p95, token_cost]
```

Maria Gomez: Approval checklist item: please attach the eval report comparing FP16 vs AWQ vs GPTQ (perplexity, exact-match for QA slices, and generation quality notes). Then I'll sign off on accuracy tradeoffs.
Ravi Nambiar: Uploaded eval_report_v2.csv to the s3 folder and linked in the README. I'll drop a short summary in this thread when calib job completes.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline created for canary: pipeline_id=canary-serve-2190012345, status=pending, will run post-calibration.
Jordan (infra): Note: canary will route 1% traffic to Dedicated GPU pool in phx region. If latency > 150ms p95 within 15m, rollback auto-triggers.
Chris Lee: OK — after job finishes I'll run local smoke: `python -m redwood.tools.smoke --model ./calib_runs/epoch42-awq --prompts tests/smoke_prompts.txt`
Ravi Nambiar: Thanks all. I'll re-upload tokenizer with pad/BOS fix in 10m and post final counts + eval link. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Thanks — adding to checklist for sign-off.
calib-bot: job_id=calib-2190012345-01 status=completed, metrics: ppl_fp16=2.12, ppl_awq=2.18, ppl_gptq=2.14, accuracy_delta_awq=+0.7%
Ravi Nambiar: Calibration done. Summary: AWQ chosen for canary (smaller size, 1% acc hit but within threshold), GPTQ kept as fallback. Tokenizer re-exported with pad_token_id=1 and BOS=1, path updated.
Chris Lee: Great — I'll kick off the local smoke and post results.
Maria Gomez: I'll review eval_report and confirm sign-off after smoke passes.
Ravi Nambiar: Closing loop here once smoke + canary metrics look good. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
